items.title: 14.10.1 Main health risks associated with air pollution (sehat ke bare khatre) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.10.1, printed pages 315-316.

blocks.text: Ozone, particulate matter (PM) aur nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) jaise pollutants asthma ke symptoms (alamaat) barha sakte hain aur asthma ka attack la sakte hain. Lambe arse ka exposure chronic cough (purani khansi) aur pneumonia jaisi saans ki infections ki wajah ban sakta hai.
ii) Cardio-vascular diseases (dil aur khoon ki naliyon ki bimariyan)

Particulate matter aur doosre pollutants ka exposure soojan, khoon ki naliyon ko nuqsan aur high blood pressure paida kar ke heart attack ka khatra barhata hai, aur aakhir mein stroke bhi ho sakta hai.
Kuch pollutants, khaas taur par particulate matter (PM) aur carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wale) compounds jaise benzene, ka lamba exposure lung cancer (phephron ka cancer) (lung cancer) karta hai.
iv) Reproductive and developmental effects (bachche paida karne aur barhne par asar)

Air pollution mardon aur auraton dono mein reproductive health (bachche paida karne ki sehat) aur fertility par bura asar dal sakti hai. Bachchon mein premature birth (waqt se pehle paidaish) aur development (barhne) ke problems ho sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Sehat ke bare khatre
rows: soojan, naliyon ka nuqsan, high blood pressure, stroke

blocks.prompt: a) Particulate matter (PM) ka air quality par kya asar hai?
blocks.explanation: Hawa mein latke particles hawa ko dhundla karte hain aur AQI barhate hain. Saans ke saath andar ja kar yeh saans ki naliyon mein soojan aur jalan karte hain, jis se asthma aur bronchitis hote hain; bareek PM2.5 lungs ki gehrai tak ja kar dil ki bimari aur lungs ke cancer ka khatra bhi barhata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) AQI kya hai? Yeh air quality kaise napta hai?
blocks.explanation: AQI (Air Quality Index) kisi khaas jagah ki hawa mein maujood pollutants (PM, NO₂, SO₂, CO, O₃) ki concentration ka measure (napne ka number) hai. Napi gai concentrations ko 0 se 500 ke ek number mein badla jata hai; number jitna bara, hawa utni kharab.

blocks.prompt: c) AQI ke different levels kya hain? Sab se safe aur sab se khatarnak range batayein.
blocks.explanation: Good 0-50 (green), moderate 51-100 (yellow), unhealthy for sensitive groups 101-150 (orange), unhealthy 151-200 (red), very unhealthy 201-300 (purple), hazardous 301-500 (maroon). Sab se safe 0-50 aur sab se khatarnak 301-500.

items: Saans ki bimariyan (asthma, pneumonia); dil aur naliyon ki bimariyan (heart attack, stroke); cancer (PM, benzene); reproductive aur developmental effects (fertility, premature birth).
